mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 90th percentiles, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 13500), the economy remains strong despite market concerns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 13500.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 750) indicate a cooling housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 750.
